entities.name: Victoria Reggie Kennedy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victoria Anne Kennedy is an American diplomat, attorney, and activist who served as the United States Ambassador to Austria from 2022 to 2025. She is the widow and the second wife of longtime U.S. senator Ted Kennedy.
